title: Nothing Pushed It Sideways
summary: Slide a puck across frictionless ice and watch it in two frames at once. From the stars it goes dead straight; from the ground it curves, because the ground turned underneath it.

sources.title: Persson, How do we understand the Coriolis force? (BAMS, 1998)
